title: announce_store: no single-writer exclusion on durable roots; second store instance seals a regression via its stale cache
description:
Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-t8ox (P2). rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs:164-182: persistent() opens state_root/floor_root with no lock or exclusive-claim check; FileStorage::new takes no lock either. Every guarantee (pin binding, floor monotonicity, replay rejection, cache consistency after failed-floor-write eviction) rests on all writes flowing through ONE store instance so the cache mirrors durable state. A second AnnounceTrustStore on the same roots (stale systemd unit beside a debug run, or a second persistent() in-process) has an independent cache: instance B load/accept validates against its stale cache, so after instance A commits seq 200, B accept(150) passes B checks and seals a CONSISTENT (state=150, floor=150) pair that load() precedes() can never flag - bypasses replay protection with zero tamper evidence. Fix directions: (a) accept() validates against the DURABLE record (re-read from storage, same fail-closed matrix as load) instead of the cache-first load() - closes the seal-regression vector regardless of instance count at one extra disk read per accept (accepts are rare; announce intervals); also subsumes the p4mf re-validation window as defense in depth; or (b) exclusive claim (flock on a lockfile in the state dir - note std File::try_lock needs rustc 1.89 > MSRV 1.81, so needs a dep or the MSRV bump; lockfile must not match the announce-pin- count filter) or (c) documented+asserted single-instance contract (weakest). Prefer (a) implemented where tests can run.

ADJUDICATED (Mark, 2026-08-30): fix direction (a) — durable re-read on accept —
plus capacity-gate durable re-count. human-only RELEASED to the fleet.

IMPL SLICES (single file: rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs):
1. Extract load_durable(iid) helper: durable state-record read with the same
   fail-closed matrix as load()'s cache-miss path (parse fail -> Corrupt,
   I/O error -> Io, missing file -> no record).
2. accept(): when storage.is_some(), validate against load_durable(iid)
   instead of cache-first load(iid). Pin-binding + seq-monotonic checks unchanged.
3. New-pin path: replace cached durable_count >= MAX with a fresh
   count_durable_state_records(state_dir)? comparison.

ACCEPTANCE TESTS:
- Regression: A=persistent(root).accept(iid,200); B=fresh persistent(root);
  B.accept(iid,150) -> Err(Corrupt); B.accept(iid,201) -> Ok; A's record intact.
- Capacity: A fills to MAX; fresh B.accept(new_pin) -> Err(Full).
- All existing announce_store tests keep passing.
